notes.title: Fangs changes plus a few other fixes.
notes.content:
Pushing one final update for the day with the following changes:

- Fangs now auto activates his running swiping attack anytime he moves and also moves normally instead of constantly moving towards the cursor.
- Fangs bats will now circle around the cursor instead of him, allowing players a little more control over where the bats are.
- Fixed an issue where unplugging a controller while playing could cause portions of the pause screen to move off screen.
- Fixed an issue with controller that could cause attacking to flicker between attacking and not attacking.
- Lowered the chance for the projectiles spawning on building hit modifier and slightly lowered the amount spawned.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
I've pushed another small patch through, with the following changes:
- Increased Patrol Mission reward.
- Substantially increased reward for defeating the boss of a stage.
- Fixed issue where the boss of the 5th stage could dash through objects.

notes.title: First Post Release Update/New Character Preview
notes.content: [p]Greetings![/p][h3][b]First Update[/b][/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/accf7d258e25ce24de2e4775301cb134b4a73519.png"][/img][/h3][p]A lot of you seem to be enjoying Heroes Unhinged, which is great to hear!  We are committed to improving where we can and our first review brought up a good point about permanent progression.  In response to this we have released an update today changing how the bonus points machine works.  It will now provide bonus points in the same way as before, but instead of lasting for just one stage, they will be permanent and apply randomly every time you enter any stage.  These bonus points will also be saved.  To compensate for this, prices for the points now start low and scale up high.  The max number of bonus points has been raised from 50 to 100.  We are throwing around ideas for other ways to provide permanent progression![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Character Preview[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/4fe989395e435067478a804cfce97669d632028a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We also want to give a preview of one of our first characters we're preparing for our first big update.  This new character is The Annihilator!  He wields a sawed-off shotgun and prefers to be close range.  His ability dashes in the direction the player is aiming, stopping at the first enemy he collides with, grabbing them and ripping them apart giving him a small heal, and a buff that provides movement speed and damage.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue that could cause saved progress to reset.
-Fix for controller stat power point selection sometimes disappearing.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Greetings!
A small update has been deployed, here's the changes!

-scaling of enemy damage has been lowered.
-scaling of enemy and structure health has been lowered.
-structure starting health increased.
-enemy projectiles now move at a slower speed.
-few graphics issues fixed.

notes.title: Demo Cosmic Power Update
notes.content:
Greetings!
We've updated the demo to use our current cosmic power system from the full game.  The old system allowed any damage to trigger cosmic powers while the new system only allows cosmic powers to trigger on heroes' attacks and abilities.  This update also reworks the cosmic burst power, giving it new functionality!

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.content:
-Fixed issue preventing trees and walls from counting towards destruction.
-Number of crystal runners required for patrol mission lowered.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings!
A small update has been applied to the demo build!  This update has small changes to spawn amount related to destruction, along with putting in place progress conversion to the full game upon release.  Any progress made in the demo will be transferred to the full version as long as a demo save is present when you first load into the full version!  Thanks!
